note: The planetary grid and the jitter budget (register decisions 319-336 and 338). Judged two ways: view/PlanetaryGrid by test_planetary_grid, headless; the probes by the grid probes' CTest tests, the number checks in test_probe_grid and the port check. The last mutant is the defect camera-relative rendering exists to prevent: test_camera catches it on the processor, and the 1 km jitter sequence through the graphics card -- seen by hand on 2026-10-04 at 0.428 px, 12.8 times the budget -- which it can only because decision 336 chose an epoch at which the prime meridian points 44.7 degrees from the celestial x axis.
